name: Tamil Nadu hospital multipurpose workers' protest
about: More than 2,500 daily-wage multipurpose health workers in Tamil Nadu government hospitals began protesting on 12 October, including a hunger strike. Police detained over 200 in Chennai.
demands: Job security, better employment conditions, action on long-pending demands.

context.question: Who are Tamil Nadu's multipurpose hospital workers?
context.short: More than 2,500 multipurpose workers in Tamil Nadu's government hospitals are employed on daily wages. They want job security and better terms, and began a hunger strike in Chennai on 12 October.
explainer: Multipurpose health workers do support work in Tamil Nadu's government multi-speciality hospitals, employed on a daily-wage basis.

They submitted a charter of demands to the health minister and announced a hunger strike near Rajarathinam Stadium in Chennai on 12 October. Police detained more than 200 people in Chennai and stopped others in their home districts.
impact: Health Minister K G Arunraj said the protest came barely five days after the demands were submitted and that the government needs time to meet them step by step.
Opposition leader Udhayanidhi Stalin criticised the pre-emptive detentions.
The workers are asking for job security and better employment conditions.
